2029.label: Plays a flashy knight check or fork that hangs the knight to a simple recapture, squandering a dominant piece for inadequate compensation.

2031.label: In endgames with advanced passed pawns, the player fails to find the specific move that directly covers or blockades the opponent's promotion square, instead playing a plausible but ineffective alternative that allows unstoppable promotion.

2035.label: Player chose a slow positional move instead of a forcing pawn check/sacrifice that deflects a key defender, winning decisive material.

2032.label: Player captures a tempting advanced/dangerous pawn but in doing so hangs a more valuable piece to a tactical shot.

2033.label: Player makes a passive developing or prophylactic move instead of capturing a free central pawn (e4 or e5) with a knight

2034.label: Player reflexively trades queens with check, missing a stronger forcing continuation (fork, sacrifice, or king attack) that would have won material or maintained a decisive attack.

2036.label: Player makes a routine developing move in the opening instead of capturing on g7/g2 with a bishop along the open long diagonal, missing a tactic that wins the exchange.

2037.label: Player gives an unsound check with a rook or knight that is immediately captured, hanging the checking piece for insufficient compensation.

2038.label: Player moves a piece to attack the opponent's queen while completely ignoring an immediate checkmate threat against their own king, resulting in instant loss.

2040.label: Trading queens (usually with check) when keeping the queen on the board preserved a draw through perpetual check or active piece play, converting drawn positions into lost endgames.

2039.label: Player makes a tempting capture (usually a pawn or knight taking on c3/d1/g6) while overlooking that the move leaves their own queen undefended or fatally exposed to tactics.

2041.label: Player moves their king to an exposed square that walks directly into a forced mating attack or devastating tactical sequence.

2042.label: Plays a slow irrelevant move (typically a pawn push) while leaving own rook or critical position hanging to an immediate tactical or promotion threat.

2044.label: Player makes an irrelevant or slow move while ignoring an opponent's imminent passed pawn promotion, failing to capture or block the critical pawn.

2045.label: In endgames, plays advancing or repositioning moves while overlooking simple captures of undefended enemy pieces that would win immediately.

2043.label: In endgame positions with passed pawns, reflexively advances the pawn toward promotion instead of first repositioning the king to support it, often hanging the pawn or allowing forced mate.

2047.label: Player chose a quiet repositioning move instead of a winning capture (usually with check) that would have won material or delivered checkmate through a forcing sequence.

2046.label: In endgames, moves the king reflexively instead of executing an available decisive tactic (winning capture, fork, or forced mate).
